title: The signed and unsigned results of CMP depend on the subsequent Jcc
summary: After the same CMP, JL tests signed less-than using SF ≠ OF, while JB tests unsigned below using CF = 1.
applies: 64-bit mode for x86-64; Intel SDM Volume 1 and Volume 2
detail: When the eight-bit 0xff is compared with 1, it is −1<1 if signed and 255>1 if it is unsigned.
boundary: It is necessary to confirm the order and width of the left and right operands; the writing order in Intel and AT&T syntax is different.
relevance: When decompiling missing types, restore the numerical interpretation used by comparisons from conditional jumps.
